# splunkctl lookups

Manage lookup table files.

## lookups auto

Wire an automatic lookup onto a sourcetype (props.conf LOOKUP-*).

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl lookups auto [OPTIONS] DEFNAME
```

```text
Requires a lookup definition (see `lookups define`) named DEFNAME to
already exist. Events of --sourcetype get enriched at search time:
each --input match field is looked up against DEFNAME, and each
--output field from a matching row is copied onto the event.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sourcetype` | text | - | Sourcetype stanza in props.conf to wire onto. [required] |
| `--input` | text | - | Match field: FIELD or FIELD:LOOKUP_FIELD (repeatable, >=1 required). FIELD is the event's field name; LOOKUP_FIELD, after a ':', is the lookup table's column name only when it differs. [required] |
| `--output` | text | - | Output field: FIELD or FIELD:RENAMED (repeatable, >=1 required). FIELD is the lookup table's column; RENAMED, after a ':', is the event field name to write it to when it differs. [required] |
| `--overwrite / --no-overwrite` | flag | true | OUTPUT (default): always overwrite. --no-overwrite: OUTPUTNEW (only fill fields not already present on the event). |
| `--app` | text | - | App to scope the props.conf stanza to (default: current namespace). |
| `--name` | text | - | LOOKUP- key suffix (default: DEFNAME). |

## lookups define

Create or update a lookup definition (transforms.conf).

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl lookups define [OPTIONS] DEFNAME
```

```text
Binds DEFNAME to a table file (--file) or a KV store collection
(--collection) — exactly one is required. Use `lookups auto` next to
wire the definition onto a sourcetype so it enriches events
automatically, or reference DEFNAME directly with `| lookup`.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | App to scope the definition to (default: current namespace). |
| `--file` | text | - | Lookup table CSV/mmdb filename (exactly one of --file/--collection). |
| `--collection` | text | - | KV store collection name (exactly one of --file/--collection). |
| `--max-matches` | integer | - | Maximum matches per input. |
| `--min-matches` | integer | - | Minimum matches required. |
| `--case-sensitive / --no-case-sensitive` | flag | - | Case-sensitive field matching (default: Splunk's own default, unset). |
| `--default-match` | text | - | Value used for the output field(s) when no match is found. |

## lookups definitions

List transforms.conf lookup-definition stanzas.

```text
splunkctl lookups definitions [OPTIONS]
```

```text
transforms.conf also holds unrelated field-transform stanzas (REGEX/
FORMAT); only stanzas shaped like a lookup definition (a `filename`
or `external_type`/`collection` key) are shown here. For the full,
unfiltered transforms.conf, use `conf list transforms`.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | Only definitions in this app (default: current namespace, which may miss app-private stanzas — pass --app to see them all). |
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |
